summary: Adds paging to the user list. The paging maths is right for full pages but crashes on an empty table.

findings.title: Empty list crashes the pager
findings.problem: `page - 1` is negative when the list is empty, so `items[page - 1]` panics.
findings.example: GET /users?page=0 on an empty table returns 500.
findings.suggestion: Return early when there are no items.
findings.comment:
`page - 1` is negative when the list is empty, so `items[page - 1]` panics.

Example: `GET /users?page=0` on an empty table.

```suggestion
if len(items) == 0 { return nil }
```

findings.title: Page size 50 is repeated in two places
findings.problem: The handler and the query both hard-code 50, so changing one silently breaks the other.
findings.comment: 50 is hard-coded here and in the query below; they have to stay equal. A shared `const pageSize = 50` would keep them in step.
